not_run.reason: Needs a source directory the server refuses to list. Root is not squashed on this export, so mongoose (which must run as root) can read every directory, and a libnfs ?uid= option on the source URL fails at the scan (finding url-options), so the scan cannot run as another user.
not_run.coverage: software tests only (walker fault injection and scan acceptance tests)

findings.summary: A source URL with libnfs options (for example ?uid=65534) fails at the scan: the walker passes the query string as part of the export path, so every mount fails and mongoose exits 1. Fails closed.
An invalid --exclude is refused before any scan or run.json, but the work-dir lock creates the work directory and its .mongoose.lock first; the man page says 'refused before anything is written'.

A publish whose rename fails (EEXIST onto a non-empty directory) leaves its .partial file in the destination tree; the cutover reports it as an extra until it is removed. Crash leftovers behave the same way and are documented; this case is not.

scripts/verify-release.sh and docs/BUILDING.md say gh 2.49 or newer, but `gh attestation verify --source-ref` first appears in gh 2.68.0; with 2.62 to 2.67 the verification fails at the provenance step.
One copy's mount failed to resolve the server name; mongoose exited 1 and a rerun was clean.
